title: Mountain Valley Drawing
description: The picture shows a wide valley with a winding path leading through hills covered in dark bushes and trees. In the background are large mountains with shaded slopes under a bright white sky.
prompt: black and white ink drawing of a wide mountain valley with a winding path curving through the foreground and midground. The hillsides are dotted with clusters of dark bushes and small trees. Layered mountain ranges fill the background with varying shades of gray on their slopes. The sky is plain white. Simple bold ink lines and brushwork define the forms.
